name: Foundation
description: Lock the non-negotiables: who this webinar is for, what transformation it promises, what they'll buy at the end.
inputs: Ideal audience, current problem, desired result, mechanism/vehicle name, offer type, CTA type, working title.
output: Sharpened promise statement, 3 candidate titles, one-sentence positioning, core tension hook.
validation: All 6 foundation fields filled + promise is specific, measurable, time-bound.
notes: Deliverables: Workshop record with Promise, Audience, Problem, Result, Mechanism, CTA populated. Blocks: Cannot advance until Promise + Audience + Desired Result are non-empty. Lens: Aligned Invitation Model — Person x Problem x Desired Result must overlap before anything else is built.

name: Audience & Belief Mapping
description: Map what the audience currently believes and what they must believe by the end in order to buy.
inputs: Current beliefs (vehicle / internal / external), objections, fears, prior attempts that failed, identity labels they use.
output: 3-layer belief shift map (Old to New for Vehicle, Internal, External), objection list with reframes, target identity statement.
validation: Each belief has Old State, New State, Proof required, and a Story slot identified.
notes: Deliverables: Minimum 3 Belief records (V/I/E) and 3+ Objection records linked to Workshop. Blocks: Cannot advance until at least one belief per layer (V/I/E) is drafted. Lens: Pre-Belief Engine + Buyer Readiness Triangle — Trust x Clarity x Relevance anchor each belief shift.

name: Structure
description: Lay out the full section architecture of the live event — the skeleton the rest of the build hangs on.
inputs: Preferred length, opener style, desired pacing, must-include moments.
output: Ordered list of 10-14 Webinar Sections (Hook > Credibility > Origin > Problem > Opportunity > Mechanism > Teaching Blocks > Belief Shifts > Proof > Case Study > Offer > CTA > Q&A > Close) with purpose + duration per section.
validation: All sections have type + purpose; total duration matches target; at least one belief is assigned to each teaching block.
notes: Deliverables: Full set of Webinar Section records linked to Workshop, each with Purpose + Duration + Section Type. Blocks: Cannot advance until every belief has at least one section carrying it. Lens: Event Ecosystem Model — the live event is the hub; sections are spokes of belief-shift work.

name: Stories
description: Attach a story to every belief shift so persuasion happens through experience, not argument.
inputs: Personal stories, client stories, origin story, failure stories, contrarian moments.
output: Story drafts in 4-beat form (Setup > Tension > Turn > Lesson), flagship origin story, story-to-belief mapping.
validation: Every belief-shift section has at least 1 linked story; origin story placed in Credibility/Origin section.
notes: Deliverables: Story Bank records linked to the Webinar Sections where they belong. Blocks: Cannot advance until every belief shift has a story attached. Lens: Pre-Belief Engine — belief moves via narrative first, logic second.

name: Analogies
description: Build the visual/verbal analogies that make the mechanism undeniable and memorable.
inputs: What concept confuses people most, what everyday thing it resembles, preferred doodle style.
output: One-line analogy + extended version + smart-board doodle description for each key concept.
validation: Mechanism reveal has flagship analogy; every abstract belief shift has a concrete analogy.
notes: Deliverables: Analogy records linked to Sections (esp. Mechanism Reveal + Teaching Blocks). Blocks: Cannot advance until the mechanism has at least one flagship analogy. Lens: Show-Up Equation — analogies raise Anticipation and Relevance before the live.

name: Proof / Research
description: Assemble the evidence stack — data, screenshots, testimonials, case studies — that makes the promise believable.
inputs: Client results, screenshots, data sources, expert quotes, prior press, metrics.
output: Proof inventory mapped to each belief; case study drafts in Before > Pivot > After format; proof-gap list.
validation: Every belief has at least 1 piece of proof; at least 1 full case study exists; no unsubstantiated claims.
notes: Deliverables: Research + Case Study + Testimonial records linked to Sections and Beliefs. Blocks: Cannot advance until every core belief has linked proof. Lens: Buyer Readiness Triangle — Trust leg is built here.

name: Offer Builder
description: Engineer the offer: core deliverable, bonuses, guarantee, price, stack order, so the CTA is the obvious next step.
inputs: What they deliver, price point, bonuses available, guarantee stance, urgency elements.
output: Offer stack with perceived value per component, bonus naming, guarantee language, price anchoring, CTA script.
validation: Stack has core + 3 or more bonuses + guarantee; perceived value is 5x price or greater; every objection is handled by something in the stack.
notes: Deliverables: Offer record + Offer Components linked + CTA Type set on Workshop. Blocks: Cannot advance until offer stack is closed and priced. Lens: Aligned Invitation — the offer must be the literal answer to Person x Problem x Desired Result.

name: Script Builder
description: Write the live-delivery script section by section, stitching stories, analogies, proof, and the offer into one movement.
inputs: Voice preferences, soundbites they love, banned phrases, delivery style.
output: Full section-by-section Talking Script + Transition In/Out + Soundbite per section + offer transition + CTA close.
validation: Every section has Talking Script + Transition In + Transition Out + at least one Soundbite.
notes: Deliverables: Scripts linked to each Webinar Section; full Workshop script exportable. Blocks: Cannot advance until every section Status is Drafted or higher. Lens: Micro-Commitment Ladder — the script builds small yeses toward the CTA.

name: Slide Blueprint
description: Design the slide deck that carries the script visually — one idea per slide, analogies as doodles, offer as stack.
inputs: Brand colors, preferred aesthetic, willingness to use doodles/photos.
output: Slide Blueprints with On-Slide Copy + Speaker Notes + Visual Direction per slide, matched to script beats.
validation: Every section has at least 1 slide; mechanism reveal, proof stack, and offer stack each have dedicated slides.
notes: Deliverables: Slide Blueprint records linked to Sections; complete blueprint exportable for design. Blocks: Cannot advance until every section has at least one slide blueprint. Lens: Friction Leak Map — visual clarity prevents leaks during the live.

name: Readiness Review
description: Grade the full build across 11 dimensions, surface gaps, and decide: presentation-ready, needs work, or not ready.
inputs: Final self-assessment, confidence level, open worries.
output: Readiness Review record with ratings for Promise Clarity, Audience Specificity, V/I/E Belief Handled, Proof Sufficiency, Story Placement, Offer Clarity, CTA Alignment, Objection Handling, Likely To Convert; Biggest Gaps; Next Actions; Overall Verdict.
validation: All 11 rating fields completed; Verdict set; if not passing, Next Actions filled.
notes: Deliverables: Readiness Review record linked to Workshop; Wizard Status on Workshop set to Ready or Flagship if verdict clears. Blocks: This is the final gate — Workshop cannot be marked Ready without a passing Readiness Review. Lens: State-Based Follow-Up Matrix — even post-review, not-ready webinars get replay/nurture paths, not deletion.
